programme.title: Million Dollar Mountain Homes - Bryan and Carrie (New)
programme.desc: S1E16 - Celebrating early retirement, Bryan and Carrie have Blue Ridge on the brain. With a big budget and an even bigger wish list, these Atlantans are set on finding a lakefront trophy home with mountain views. But the hunt becomes complicated when water levels, lake activity, and close-range views challenge the serenity of mountain living. Which one will top the mountain? (Home improvement)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Tchotchkes, Not Poppycocksis
programme.desc: S18E1 - In Orange, Dave zeroes in on a stack of Benjamins; Dusty and Lupe go really big and manage to stay out of the weeds; Mary gets herself all chakra'd in Fullerton, while she and her Texas Teammate Lisa spawn some seriously spirited stuff. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - It's Not Easy Drinking Green
programme.desc: S18E6 - Lisa hosts Kenny at her "Airbnb" and sends him to Riverside, trapping him with a mostly healthy breakfast; Ivy presses his luck and is rewarded for it; Brandi lets her sense of humor guide her, and it's no laughing matter. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Hauntington Beach
programme.desc: S17E11 - It's a spooky All Hallow's Eve in Huntington Beach, as Kenny books an appearance with his dark side; Brandi finds evidence of a possible payday; Ivy does what he can with whatever he has; Mary's locker requires some rescuing. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The War of the Riaches
programme.desc: S18E5 - In Fullerton, Dusty drags a busy Lupe to the auction, where she decides to show him that "packed" isn't always "stacked;" Dave refuses to let KinderCare influence his choices, while Emily, intent on following the mystery, ends up short a wheel. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Baby Jesus, Take the Wheel
programme.desc: S18E3 - Torrance gives props to Dusty & Lupe who are haunted by their locker; Kenny manages to kill several birds with one locker; Brandi gets all medieval with some strange music boxes, while Lisa re-joins the rest of the fleas to drop some new records. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The Puppet Master of Lancaster
programme.desc: S18E2 - The Lord of Lancaster tries to levy tariffs on his visitors, but Dusty & Lupe manage to distract him long enough to cut out a profit; Dave is finally able to see the light. Kenny's new friends fit him like a glove. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The Skeet Smell of Success!
programme.desc: S18E7 - In Garden Grove, Lisa shatters her record for most liquid in a locker; Brandi pulls some profit out of an otherwise unremarkable unit; Emily struggles to get herself in the black, while Ivy has to return to a locker he grabbed in Orange. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - YUUUPocalypse Now!
programme.desc: S16E4 - Ivy takes an opportunity to practice his dart game as the buyers head to Riverside; Rene exchanges poker for a chance to get his Becker on; Brandi ropes in more than she bargained for, but a surprise shows up. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - I Am Gary, Hear Me Bid!
programme.desc: S16E6 - The buyers return to Moreno Valley in hopes of finding Mo Value; Rene's "Bring your Daughter to Work" day turns into a beach day; Kenny taps into his childhood to try to find a profit; Dusty's throwback locker dispenses some tidy gains. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Like Dollars for Chocolate
programme.desc: S17E10 - Everything is coming up "Brandi" in Banning, as she milks all she can out of her buy; Ivy knows good tools when he sees them; Lisa forms some sweet success out of an otherwise bland unit, while Kenny scores on a highbrow horseplay hoard. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Goody Two Hundred-Shoes
programme.desc: S17E8 - Kenny gets ganged up on in Riverside by the field of buyers; Dave buys an old unit and takes a voyage back in time; Ivy scores a locker that inspires him to go clubbing; Emily puts her foot down with a statement buy on a massive locker. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: David Jeremiah
programme.desc: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming. (Religious)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - Is It Worth It?
programme.desc: S1E1 - New corrections officer Zach encounters a violent inmate during his first day on the job; Ariel works to overcome her timid persona; prisoners taunt Carlos; Tyler locates contraband in the prison kitchen. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - Respect
programme.desc: S1E2 - Inmates do not appreciate Andrew's aggressive approach; Keith looks for the best way out of a potentially volatile situation; Ariel begins work on the line; one rookie cracks under the pressure of the job. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - Gangland
programme.desc: S1E3 - Francisco reacts when a fight erupts; Tyler crosses the line with a prison gang leader; Keith assists the elite gang unit; Cohen, a third-generation corrections officer, aims to prove his worth. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - The Con Game
programme.desc: S1E4 - A career criminal takes advantage of Mangin; Andrew works to bust a gang member who is dealing drugs; Ariel faces the challenges of being a female corrections officer. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - The Riot
programme.desc: S1E5 - Zach investigates a fight; Keith deals with unstable and violent inmates; Ariel wrestles with the uncertainty of the job; PNM's tragic past acts as both a haunting reminder and a catalyst for change. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Rookie Year - The Drug Trade
programme.desc: S1E6 - Despite efforts to keep the prison clean, narcotics always find their way into the prison; Francisco suspects an inmate is high; Andrew takes inmates on a high-risk work detail outside the prison; Bruce struggles with high expectations. (Reality, Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Officer Cam - Inmate Uprising
programme.desc: S1E1 - Inside two of America's most pressurized jails, the cameras are always rolling; in Clayton County, Georgia, crumbling infrastructure, limited shower access and shrinking free time have pushed inmates to a breaking point; tensions boil over into confrontations; officers are attacked. Inmates fashion weapons; what begins as frustration over living conditions escalates into every jail administrator's worst nightmare: an inmate uprising. (Reality)

programme.title: Behind Bars: Officer Cam - Shank Search
programme.desc: S1E2 - In Clayton County Jail, an inmate attacks another in handcuffs in one of the facility's most alarming acts of violence; elsewhere, what looks like a fight reveals a far more complicated story once investigators piece together the full picture; and with contraband still flowing, Chief Green leads a sweeping shakedown that uncovers exactly how much is hiding in plain sight; amid the chaos, officers defuse a tricky situation. (Reality)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Royal Rumble in the 2000s
programme.desc: S3E14 - The Royal Rumble is one of the wildest events on the WWE calendar; and in the intense decade of the 2000s, great Rumble moments were etched in history, featuring the unforgettable WWE Championship match between Cactus Jack and Triple H, Santino Marella breaking a record for the shortest entrant, John Cena and Batista's epic battle in 2005 and much more! (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Smackdown: The First Decade
programme.desc: S1E3 - Featuring the biggest stars in professional wrestling such as The Rock, Hulk Hogan and John Cena, WWE's SmackDown is the premiere destination for the most exciting matches and entertaining moments on network television. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Andre the Giant
programme.desc: S2E13 - Throughout the storied history of WWE, there has never been a Superstar quite as large as "The Eighth Wonder of the World," Andre the Giant; unforgettable moments of his enormous strength include his showdown with Hulk Hogan at Shea Stadium, the body slam contest with Big John Stud, his triumph at Survivor Series, his extraordinary title win and so much more. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Championship Matches of the 90s
programme.desc: S2E14 - The WWE Championship is the richest prize any Superstar can attain. And in the 1990s, the competition for the coveted gold was at an all-time high. Relive the greatest battles of the decade for the WWE Championship, such as "Stone Cold" Steve Austin vs. The Rock, Bret "Hitman" Hart vs. Owen Hart, Shawn Michaels vs. Mick Foley, Hulk Hogan vs. the Ultimate Warrior and more! (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Elimination Chamber
programme.desc: S3E17 - The elimination chamber has struck fear into WWE superstars for over 20 years, leading to the creation of its own namesake event; relive some of the shocking moments from the premium live event, like Goldberg spearing Chris Jericho through the plexiglass in 2003, the first-ever women's elimination chamber in 2018, the debut of Kevin Owens as he takes on John Cena in 2015 and more. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Raw in the '90s
programme.desc: S1E1 - "Monday Night Raw" airs in 1993 and instantly becomes must-see TV; skyrocketed by the popularity of Superstars like Stone Cold Steve Austin and factions like Degeneration X, this era is a fan favorite. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - The Bloodline
programme.desc: S1E11 - Looking at the journey of The Bloodline from their rich Samoan heritage of the squared circle; led by Roman Reigns, each member has reached the very heights of this industry; acknowledge The Bloodline with their moments. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Shocking Comebacks
programme.desc: S2E12 - One of the most exciting aspects of WWE has always been a Superstar's return to the squared circle; the best comebacks have always been when the fans least expect it like the surprise returns of Bret "The Hitman" Hart. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - \"Rowdy\" Roddy Piper
programme.desc: S3E3 - The incomparable "Rowdy" Roddy Piper stood above all when it came to antagonizing audiences worldwide. The Hot Rod is an all-time WWE Legend, and his antics will be remembered for generations to come. Relive his unforgettable boxing match with Mr. T at WrestleMania 2, his instant classic with Bret "Hitman" Hart, and the talk show that started it all, Piper's Pit! (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Jake \"The Snake\" Roberts
programme.desc: S3E8 - Known for carrying a live snake with him to the ring, Jake Roberts was not only a vicious competitor, but a true master of the spoken word, delivering some of the most memorable promos during his famed career; relive moments like his partnership with legendary rock music icon Alice Cooper, unleashing his snake onto "Macho Man" Randy Savage, his unforgettable feud with "Ravishing" Rick Rude and so much more. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - nWo
programme.desc: S1E4 - The professional wrestling world changes with the emergence of the New World Order or nWo; when the black and white group takes over, WCW reaches new heights in TV ratings and pop culture. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Saturday Night's Main Event
programme.desc: S2E10 - Breaking ground as the first professional wrestling program to air on network television, "Saturday Night's Main Event" was home to many of the biggest moments, like Macho Man Randy Savage and Hulk Hogan's formation of the Mega Powers. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - WrestleMania in the 80s
programme.desc: S1E9 - We journey back to the beginnings of WrestleMania's rich history, the 1980s; featuring unforgettable moments like Hulk Hogan body slamming Andre the Giant. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Survivor Series in the 2000s
programme.desc: S2E16 - In the 2000s, anything could and usually did happen; some of the memorable moments of WWE's fall classic like Kane's brutal match against Shane McMahon, Team WWE vs. Team Alliance (WCW and ECW), Brock Lesnar taking on the Big Show. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE LFG - The Kam Hendrix Experience (New)
programme.desc: S3E14 - PJ Vasa steps into the ring with her mentor -- NXT Superstar Wendy Choo; tensions rise as Coach Bubba Ray has some tough love for Elijah Holyfield after a match with Chris Island; Kam Hendrix makes his explosive return to LFG in the main event against the debuting Olympian, Shady Elnahas. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - Hulk Hogan (New)
programme.desc: S3E27 - Pop culture icon Hulk Hogan had an incredible career spanning over 5 decades and earning him 12 world championships. Over the years, he became the ultimate definition of a global superstar. We celebrate the immortal moments of the Hulkster, like his legendary match with The Iron Sheik, his Icon vs Icon match against The Rock, his shocking WCW heel turn and the breathtaking slam of Andre the Giant. (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: WWE's Greatest Moments - SummerSlam in the '90s (New)
programme.desc: S3E28 - SummerSlam has long been one of the hottest PLE's of WWE and the decade of the 90s certainly lived up to the heat! Witness ladder matches, a steel cage match and even a first-ever Boiler Room Brawl. Also, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin defends his WWE Championship against Triple H and Mankind with Jesse "The Body" Ventura as guest referee. And we're all invited to a Macho wedding that served as the main event at Madison Square Garden! (Reality, Pro wrestling)

programme.title: Inside Africa - Uganda's Boxing Renaissance
programme.desc: Once known as the "Pearl of Africa" in the ring, Uganda is looking to rebuild its boxing industry through a televised Champions League competition; we film behind the scenes of a fight night, featuring two talented boxers looking to secure their place at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland. - Isha Sesay (Travel)

programme.title: African Voices - Gugu Gumede and S'Dumo Mtshali
programme.desc: In Johannesburg, Larry Madowo sits down with Gugu Gumede and S'Dumo Mtshali, the stars of Netflix's hit show "The Polygamist"; together, they talk about the show's global success, what it means to play such complex characters, and where African storytelling is headed; the actors also open up about their personal journeys and the challenges they face in the industry, from dealing with fame and typecasting to pushing for better protections for actors. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: Quest's World of Wonder - Seville, Spain
programme.desc: Richard shakes off the winter doldrums with a trip to Seville, Spain. He goes sweet on sour oranges in search of his favorite marmalade, and learns that a long-standing Seville tradition requires dressing the part. Richard takes in one of the most Instagrammable landmarks only to discover many people miss the hidden treasure buried below, and he learns the secret to buying some of the best sweets is a "religious" experience. (Travel)

programme.title: Marketplace Africa - Uganda's Changing Fishing Industry; Michael Ogbalu (New)
programme.desc: Demand for fish in everyday diets across Uganda has spurred rapid growth for the country's fishing industry; the sector continues to evolve, with homegrown companies looking to expand. We take a look at how they're looking to scale and train; also, businesses across the African continent face a myriad of challenges when it comes to cross-border transactions. (Bus./financial, News)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Hell On Wheels
programme.desc: S2E4 - Remember when hitting the road meant flirting with disaster?; from rumble seats that turn passengers into projectiles, to scorching cigarette lighters built right into the dash, to cars that have a habit of going up in flames, even a simple trip can go south; these are the bright ideas and questionable designs that turn people daily commute into a demolition derby; it's a high-speed, white-knuckle ride back to a time when the rules of the road were still being written. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Anything for a Buck
programme.desc: S2E10 - When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb. From dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover. Whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living. (Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Young & the Reckless
programme.desc: S2E11 - When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive. From launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go--and the consequences that came with it. Armed with cherry bombs, slingshots, and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Animal Anarchy
programme.desc: S2E13 - From racing atop ostriches and wrestling wild bears, to raising pet skunks at home and ordering monkeys through the mail, we once welcomed the wild into our lives in some truly staggering ways. These are the unforgettable attractions, unusual pets, and head-scratching animal encounters that blurred the line between affection and recklessness. It's a rowdy, unpredictable trip back to the critter-filled close calls that prove our hazardous history was anything but tame. (Documentary)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever. - Katherine Heigl, Tom Wilkinson, Linda Emond, Grace Gummer, Alexis Bledel (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Holden and Banky are best friends and authors of a popular comic book. Holden falls in love with Alyssa, who happens to be a lesbian. Holden's relationship with Alyssa strains his life-long friendship with Banky, and soon the relationship between Holden and Alyssa has problems when he cannot deal with her past. - Ben Affleck, Joey Lauren Adams, Jason Lee, Dwight Ewell, Jason Mewes (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody... - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s). - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. - Shirley Henderson, Ciarán Hinds, Allison Janney, Michael Lerner, Chris Marquette (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber, Ross Brodar, Josh Charles (Drama)

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). - Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Judi Dench, Fergie (Musical, Romance)

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. - Ariana DeBose, Matt Shingledecker, Steffanie Leigh, Sharon Washington, Jana Lee Hamblin (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - Deanna Jarvis, Derick Agyemang, Kylee Evans, Jonathan Goad, Ish Morris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
programme.desc: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. - Jennifer Garner, Maika Monroe, Cody Fern, Noah Silver, Justin Kirk (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Young Adult
programme.desc: Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school. - Charlize Theron, Patton Oswalt, Patrick Wilson, Elizabeth Reaser, Jill Eikenberry (Comedy drama, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Ryan and Jennifer are opposites who definitely do not attract. At least that's what they always believed. When they met as twelve-year-olds, they disliked one another. When they met again as teenagers, they loathed each other. But when they meet in college, the uptight Ryan and the free-spirited Jennifer find that their differences bind them together and a rare friendship develops. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Claire Forlani, Jason Biggs, Amanda Detmer, Heather Donahue (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. - Richard Gere, Jennifer Lopez, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Lisa Ann Walter (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music)

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: M'Lynn (Sally Field) is the mother of bride-to-be Shelby Eatenton (Julia Roberts), and as friend Truvy Jones (Dolly Parton) fixes the women's hair for the ceremony, they welcome a helping hand from aspiring beautician Annelle Dupuy DeSoto (Daryl Hannah). Diabetic Shelby has a health scare, which is averted but doesn't bode well for her hopes of having children. Time passes, and the women and their friends encounter tragedy and good fortune, growing stronger and closer in the process. - Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls." - Ellen Burstyn, James Caan, Ann-Margret, Jane Curtin, Loretta Devine (Comedy)

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. - Zoe Lister-Jones, Adam Pally, Fred Armisen, Susie Essman, Hannah Simone (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees, Ana Gasteyer, Stephanie Beatriz (Comedy)

programme.title: Peep World
programme.desc: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday. - Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman, Rainn Wilson, Judy Greer, Kate Mara (Comedy)

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Ryan and Jennifer are opposites who definitely do not attract. At least that's what they always believed. When they met as twelve-year-olds, they disliked one another. When they met again as teenagers, they loathed each other. But when they meet in college, the uptight Ryan and the free-spirited Jennifer find that their differences bind them together and a rare friendship develops. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Claire Forlani, Jason Biggs, Amanda Detmer, Heather Donahue (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: She's All That
programme.desc: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Paul Walker, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series

programme.title: Daniela Forever

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: She's All That

Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. - Samuel L. Jackson, Bernie Mac, Sharon Leal, Adam Herschman, Sean Hayes (Comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: A big screen spin-off of the "Saturday Night Live" skit. Rob Lowe plays a producer that wants to take the public access "Wayne's World" to the world of commercial television. Wayne (Mike Myers) and Garth (Dana Carvey) battle to save their show and Wayne's girlfriend from Lowe. - Mike Myers, Dana Carvey, Rob Lowe, Tia Carrere, Brian Doyle Murray (Comedy, Music)

programme.title: Young Adult
programme.desc: Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school. - Charlize Theron, Patton Oswalt, Patrick Wilson, Elizabeth Reaser, Jill Eikenberry (Comedy drama, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees, Ana Gasteyer, Stephanie Beatriz (Comedy)

programme.title: College
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dumps him, high-school senior Kevin (Drake Bell) does not feel like attending freshman orientation weekend at Fairmont University, but his pals (Andrew Caldwell, Kevin Covais) drag him along anyway. Once there, the teens meet members of the rowdiest fraternity on campus, who introduce them to the college party scene, as well as a few sorority girls. - Drake Bell, Andrew Caldwell, Kevin Covais, Nick Zano, Zach Cregger (Comedy)

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante. - Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, Kevin Bacon, Nathan Fillion (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives. - Josh Hartnett, Charithra Chandran, Marko Zaror, Katee Sackhoff, Julian Kostov (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Wayne's World

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. - Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. - Betsy Palmer, Adrienne King, Harry Crosby, Laurie Bartram, Mark Nelson (Horror)

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. - Amy Steel, John Furey, Adrienne King, Kirsten Baker, Stuart Charno (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape. - Arnold Schwarzenegger, Maria Conchita Alonso, Richard Dawson, Yaphet Kotto, Jim Brown (Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Terry Crews, Randy Couture (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. - Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, Richard Castellano, Robert Duvall (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. - Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, Robert De Niro, John Cazale (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs. - Barbra Streisand, Seth Rogen, Brett Cullen, Colin Hanks, Adam Scott (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: An unwitting man's (Jim Carrey) life is arranged for him, captured on hidden cameras and broadcast internationally.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). - Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Judi Dench, Fergie (Musical, Romance)

programme.title: The King's Speech
programme.desc: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. - Colin Firth, Geoffrey Rush, Helena Bonham Carter, Guy Pearce, Timothy Spall (Historical drama, Biography)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. - Nicolas Cage, Michael Peña, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Maria Bello, Stephen Dorff (Drama)

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia. - Joseph Fiennes, Jude Law, Rachel Weisz, Bob Hoskins, Ed Harris (War, Drama, Action, Historical drama, Romance)

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa. - Andrew Garfield, Richard Pyros, Jacob Warner, Milo Gibson, Sam Worthington (War, Historical drama, Biography, Docudrama)

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom. - Daniel Craig, Liev Schreiber, Jamie Bell, Alexa Davalos, Allan Corduner (Historical drama, War)

programme.title: Distant Thunder
programme.desc: A Chicago teenager (Ralph Macchio) searches the Pacific Northwest woods for his Vietnam-veteran father (John Lithgow). - John Lithgow, Ralph Macchio, Kerrie Keane, Reb Brown, Janet Margolin (Drama)

programme.title: American Son
programme.desc: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving. - Nick Cannon, Melonie Diaz, Matt O'Leary, Jay Hernandez, Erica Gluck (Drama)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. - Dustin Hoffman, Laurence Olivier, Roy Scheider, William Devane, Marthe Keller (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War)

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation. - Dan Bakkedahl, Kevin Dillon, Josh Duhamel, James Roday Rodriguez, Nick Swardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression. - Margot Robbie, Travis Fimmel, Garrett Hedlund, Kerry Condon, Finn Cole (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Terry Crews, Randy Couture (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Dolph Lundgren, Chuck Norris (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Antonio Banderas, Jet Li, Wesley Snipes (Action, Thriller, Adventure)

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table. - Jason Statham, Sylvester Stallone, Andy Garcia, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Megan Fox (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia. - Joseph Fiennes, Jude Law, Rachel Weisz, Bob Hoskins, Ed Harris (War, Drama, Action, Historical drama, Romance)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1980, and Björn Borg is the top tennis player in the world, dominating the sport both on and off the court. A powerful and rigorously disciplined player, there is only one obstacle in his pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship: the highly talented but ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe. With three days until the tournament begins, Borg trains religiously in his lavish Monaco home, aided by his coach and mentor Lennart and girlfriend Mariana. - Sverrir Gudnason, Shia LaBeouf, Stellan Skarsgård, Tuva Novotny, Ian Blackman (Drama)

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Don't Knock Twice
programme.desc: A mother looking to reconnect with her estranged daughter attracts the attention of a demonic witch. - Katee Sackhoff, Lucy Boynton, Javier Botet, Nick Moran, Jordan Bolger (Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond is a New York City money launderer who wakes up with no memory and millions of dollars in stolen cash and drugs. He must soon scour the streets in search of answers while trying to dodge a crew of violent and crooked cops. - Liam Hemsworth, Emory Cohen, Diane Guerrero, Nickola Shreli, Suraj Sharma (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1980, and Björn Borg is the top tennis player in the world, dominating the sport both on and off the court. A powerful and rigorously disciplined player, there is only one obstacle in his pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship: the highly talented but ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe. programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. - Nicolas Cage, Michael Peña, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Maria Bello, Stephen Dorff (Drama)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: When the body of Army Capt. Elizabeth Campbell (Leslie Stefanson) is found on a Georgia military base, two investigators, Warrant Officers Paul Brenner (John Travolta) and Sara Sunhill (Madeleine Stowe), are ordered to solve her murder. What they uncover is anything but clear-cut. Unseemly details emerge about Campbell's life, leading to allegations of a possible military cover-up of her death and the involvement of her father, Lt. Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). - John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Leslie Stefanson (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: Law student Martin Bells (Ewan McGregor) needs to make some money, and so he takes a side job as a night watchman in a morgue. He thinks he'll have time to study, but with a serial killer on the loose -- one with a propensity for necrophilia -- he has to be more alert than ever. While at work, Martin starts putting together the clues and realizes that the police, including Inspector Thomas Cray (Nick Nolte), have good reason to make him their prime suspect. - Ewan McGregor, Nick Nolte, Josh Brolin, Patricia Arquette, Alix Koromzay (Horror, Drama)

programme.title: The Presidio
programme.desc: Ex-military policeman Jay Austin (Mark Harmon) is now a San Francisco detective. When his former MP partner is killed at a military base, he takes the case. But after arriving at the crime scene, he realizes he must look to his old rival, Lt. Col. Alan Caldwell (Sean Connery), for help. Austin then falls for Caldwell's daughter, Donna (Meg Ryan), further complicating matters. Still, the two men push on in their search, learning to respect one another as they pursue the killer. - Sean Connery, Mark Harmon, Meg Ryan, Jack Warden, Mark Blum (Action)

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." - Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash, Katt Williams, Gracie Whitton (Comedy)

programme.title: The Two Jakes
programme.desc: Private investigator and war veteran Jake Gittes is hired by real estate developer Jake Berman for some run-of-the-mill matrimonial work. After Berman shoots his wife's lover, who happens to be his own business partner, Gittes is drawn into a web of conspiracy and deceit involving the oil reserves beneath Los Angeles. While investigating, Gittes hears a voice from his past that causes him to revisit a traumatic case in Chinatown. - Jack Nicholson, Harvey Keitel, Meg Tilly, Madeleine Stowe, Eli Wallach (Mystery, Dark comedy, Romance, Crime drama)

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: Liquor salesman and part-time prizefighter Chuck Wepner gets the chance to take on Muhammad Ali in a highly publicized title fight, launching him to sudden fame.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree. - Denzel Washington, Kelly Lynch, Russell Crowe, Stephen Spinella, William Forsythe (Action)

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe). - Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan, Charlotte Le Bon, Anna Geislerová, Toby Jones (Historical drama, War, Thriller)

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it. - Ryan Phillippe, Jesse Bradford, Adam Beach, John Benjamin Hickey, John Slattery (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. - Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, David Suchet, Navid Negahban (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues. - Emile Hirsch, Brian Cox, Ophelia Lovibond, Michael McElhatton, Olwen Kelly (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott, Jerry O'Connell, Jessica Szohr (Horror, Thriller)

The co-dependent teens plan to score booze and babes so they can become part of the in-crowd, but separation anxiety and two bored police officers complicate the pair's self-proclaimed mission. - Jonah Hill, Michael Cera, Christopher Mintz-Plasse, Bill Hader, Seth Rogen (Comedy, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: When John Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) was a little boy, he made a wish that Ted (Seth MacFarlane), his beloved teddy bear, would come alive. Thirty years later, foul-mouthed Ted is still John's constant companion, much to the chagrin of Lori (Mila Kunis), John's girlfriend. Though Lori's displeasure is exacerbated by the pair's constant consumption of beer and weed, she's not the one who's most disappointed with John; it may take the intervention of John's boyhood toy to help him grow up at last. - Mark Wahlberg, Mila Kunis, Joel McHale, Giovanni Ribisi, Patrick Warburton (Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Ted 2
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves. - Mark Wahlberg, Amanda Seyfried, Jessica Barth, Giovanni Ribisi, Morgan Freeman (Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first? - Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher, Cary Elwes, Kevin Kline, Lake Bell (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Dedication
programme.desc: When children's author Henry Roth (Billy Crudup) loses his longtime illustrator, his publisher sends him a new artist, Lucy (Mandy Moore). He is a tangle of neuroses and nastiness, and he does everything he can to alienate her, even though he must deliver his latest book in less than a month. Secretly Henry begins to fall in love with Lucy, and at the same time, her ex-boyfriend returns to try to win her back. - Billy Crudup, Mandy Moore, Dianne Wiest, Bob Balaban, Bobby Cannavale (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: This Must Be the Place
programme.desc: At 50 years of age, former rock star Cheyenne (Sean Penn) still dresses the part and lives in Ireland off the royalties and dividends from smart investments. The death of his estranged father brings Cheyenne back to New York, where he discovers the old man had one obsession: to hunt down a Nazi war criminal (Heinz Lieven). Cheyenne decides to pick up the quest where his late father left off, and sets out at his own pace on a journey across America. - Sean Penn, Frances McDormand, Judd Hirsch, Eve Hewson, Kerry Condon (Drama)

programme.desc: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety. - Oscar Isaac, Charlotte Le Bon, Christian Bale, Shohreh Aghdashloo, Marwan Kenzari (Historical drama, Romance)

programme.title: Get On Up
programme.desc: James Brown was born in extreme poverty in 1933 South Carolina and survived abandonment, abuse and jail to become one of the most influential musicians of the 20th century. He joined a gospel group as a teenager, but the jazz and blues along the "chitlin' circuit" became his springboard to fame. Although his backup musicians came and went, Brown retained the ability to mesmerize audiences with his music, signature moves and sexual energy. - Chadwick Boseman, Nelsan Ellis, Dan Aykroyd, Viola Davis, Lennie James (Biography, Docudrama)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show - A Plaque for Mayberry
programme.desc: S1E25 - The entire town is shocked when they discover that Otis, the town drunk, is a direct descendant of a Revolutionary War hero. - Andy Griffith, Ronny Howard, Don Knotts, Frances Bavier (Sitcom)

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show - The Inspector
programme.desc: S1E26 - Andy and Barney find out that the state inspector is a stickler for rules. Andy wins the inspector over when he manages to apprehend a shooter without any injuries. - Andy Griffith, Ronny Howard, Don Knotts, Frances Bavier (Sitcom)

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns. - Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Marc de Jonge, Kurtwood Smith, Spiros Focas (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case. - Kurt Russell, William Baldwin, Robert De Niro, Donald Sutherland, Jennifer Jason Leigh (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Classic 1970s disaster movie about a fire that breaks out in a state-of-the-art San Francisco high-rise building during the opening ceremony attended by a host of A-list guests. An overworked fire chief and the building's architect must cooperate in the struggle to save lives and subdue panic while a corrupt, cost-cutting contractor tries to evade responsibility for the disaster. - Steve McQueen, Paul Newman, William Holden, Faye Dunaway, Fred Astaire (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Poseidon Adventure
programme.desc: En route from New York City to Greece on New Year's Eve, majestic passenger ship the S.S. Poseidon is overtaken by a tidal wave. With the captain (Leslie Nielsen) dead, surviving passengers, including the passionate Rev. Scott (Gene Hackman), band together in the ship's ballroom. The group struggles to avert fires, flooding, structural instability and mechanical malfunctions as they make their way through a maze of ladders and tunnels in their desperate attempt to escape a watery grave. - Gene Hackman, Ernest Borgnine, Shelley Winters, Red Buttons, Carol Lynley (Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Backdraft

programme.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
programme.desc: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert. - Clint Eastwood, Eli Wallach, Lee Van Cleef, Aldo Giuffré, Mario Brega (Western)

programme.title: Desperado
programme.desc: Mariachi (Antonio Banderas) plunges headfirst into the dark border underworld when he follows a trail of blood to the last of the infamous Mexican drug lords, Bucho (Joaquim de Almeida), for an action-packed, bullet-riddled showdown. With the help of his best friend (Steve Buscemi) and a beautiful bookstore owner (Salma Hayek), the Mariachi tracks Bucho, takes on his army of desperados, and leaves a trail of blood of his own. - Antonio Banderas, Salma Hayek, Joaquim de Almeida, Cheech Marin, Steve Buscemi (Action)

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: A Mexican village is at the mercy of Calvera, the leader of a band of outlaws. The townspeople, too afraid to fight for themselves, hire seven American gunslingers to free them from the bandits' raids. The professional gunmen train the villagers to defend themselves, then plan a trap for the evil Calvera. - Yul Brynner, Eli Wallach, Steve McQueen, Horst Buchholz, Charles Bronson (Western)

programme.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

programme.title: Pale Rider
programme.desc: When property owner Coy LaHood (Richard Dysart) starts using a band of hooligans to terrorize a group of small-town gold miners into giving up their territory, an enigmatic man named "Preacher" (Clint Eastwood) arrives in town. Preacher fends off the attacks, and then goes directly to LaHood to negotiate. When the miners, led by Hull Barret (Michael Moriarty), refuse the terms, LaHood sends in Marshall Stockburn (John Russell) to take down Preacher and the others. - Clint Eastwood, Michael Moriarty, Carrie Snodgress, Christopher Penn, Richard Dysart (Western)

programme.title: The Outlaw Josey Wales
programme.desc: Josey Wales watches helplessly as his wife and child are murdered by Union men led by Capt. Terrill. Seeking revenge, Wales joins the Confederate Army. He refuses to surrender when the war ends, but his fellow soldiers go to hand over their weapons -- and are massacred by Terrill. Wales guns down some of Terrill's men and flees to Texas, where he tries to make a new life for himself, but the bounty on his head endangers him and his new surrogate family. - Clint Eastwood, Chief Dan George, Sondra Locke, Bill McKinney, John Vernon (Western)

programme.title: Young Guns
